text:
julia: FYI canary v2.5.1 at 30% is showing a rising p95 in us-west2, started ~8m ago :chart_with_upwards_trend:
deploy-bot: rollout status: v2.5.1 -> 30% traffic (us-west2). metrics snapshot: p95=810ms (baseline 420ms), errors=0.4%
mike: yep I'm seeing the same on the per-pod panel. trending across pods not just one spike.
julia: looks like it's correlated with requests around seq len ~500-600
ashley: no kernel flag changes in this PR. could be a regression in the attention kernel selection.
deploy-bot: autopilot note: autorevert threshold = p95 > 750ms sustained 5m. threshold breached 4m ago. scheduled auto-revert in ~1m unless suppressed.
pm-ron: if autotriggers we'll need a customer-facing note. do we want to suppress and triage manually?
ops-jen: recommend manual hold. traffic still flowing and error rate small. pin at 30% and run quick pod restarts / health probes.
mike: agree. try targeted restarts on two pods that show worst p95, check kv-cache hit rates afterwards.
julia: i've pinned traffic at 30% and applied a manual hold. deploy-bot: traffic pinned by julia; autopilot rollback suppressed.
mike: grabbing logs from pod-07 - seeing attention latency jump near token boundary ~512, maybe kernel selection flips.
ashley: if it's kernel related we should rollback to v2.5.0 which uses quant-kernel v1.3. hotpatch unlikely to be quick.
pm-ron: draft for customers: "Canary paused for v2.5.1 due to increased latency in a subset of requests. We're investigating; no customer errors observed." ops-jen ok to send?
ops-jen: send and tag support for monitoring.
deploy-bot: suggested rollback target v2.5.0 (build 20260321.2). estimated rollback duration ~4m (rolling restarts). impact: brief connection resets.
julia: proposal — try two pod restarts first. if cluster p95 doesn't recover below 550ms within 6m, execute rollback.
mike: doing restarts on pod-06 and pod-07 now. will report metrics in 2m.
sre-bot: metric update: pod-07 p95 down to 520ms after restart, cluster p95 now 560ms.
julia: that's promising. keep the hold for 10m to be safe. if it regresses above 650ms sustained we roll back.
pm-ron: customer note updated to "paused". will post rollback update if we take action.
mike: logging decision metadata: reason=canary-p95-drift; action=manual-hold+pod-restart; rollback-condition=6m sustained >650ms; rollback-target=v2.5.0
ashley: blocking rollforward in release notes until we complete a postmortem if rollback occurs.
julia: ok will monitor and update thread in 10m. thanks all :hourglass:
